items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: And then he and Genevieve christened my son. Genevieve was Gleason’s wife.

ctx.x: And I learned yesterday that Jackie Gleason is your son’s Godfather?
Yeah. Well I stood up for Gleason’s wedding, this is how that happened. And then he and Genevieve christened my son. Genevieve was Gleason’s wife.
Were you able over the years to keep track of how many records you played on?
